items: MARY: I've got some tomatoes out of the [freezer picture] .......freezer....... . Where is the big red [saucepan picture] (1) ..................... ? I want to make some soup.
JOHN: Look, it's in the [cupboard picture] (2) ..................... under the [sink picture] (3) ..................... .
MARY: Oh, so it is. Thanks. Now where's my favourite [knife picture] (4) ..................... for cutting vegetables?
JOHN: It's right there in front of you. Between the [hob picture] (5) ..................... and the [microwave picture] (6) .....................
MARY: Thanks. Let's have a [cup picture] (7) ..................... of tea first.
JOHN: Good idea. I'll make it. Where's the [teapot picture] (8) ..................... ?
MARY: There, on the [shelf picture] (9) ..................... , next to the [frying pan picture] (10) ..................... .

exercises.instruction: Use the picture clues to complete the crossword. The first one is done for you. What is the word in the grey section?
Choose the right verbs from the box to complete these questions.
items: Example: Would you like me to ..........do.......... the washing-up?

exercises.instruction: Put the words together to make five compound nouns for things that you find in the kitchen. Example: .......teapot.......
